title: S. N. Bhatt Memorial Excellence Fellowship Program 2027
about: ICTS summer research programme for undergraduate and master's students in science and engineering, typically mid-May to mid-July. Open to Indian and foreign nationals. Applications close 15 December 2026.
requirements: Students finishing their third or fourth year by May 2027 (exceptional second-year students may apply)
